name: Edward A. Buchanan
office: Secretary of State (2018–2022); District Court Judge, Eighth Judicial District
notes: Attorney. Born in Fort Lauderdale, Florida (Wyoming Legislature member profile; official gubernatorial appointment announcement).

Education: B.A. in political science, University of Wyoming, 1990; M.A. in public administration, University of Colorado, 1994; J.D., University of Wyoming, 1998 (Wyoming Legislature 2005 House District 4 member biography; Governor Gordon appointment announcement of July 30, 2022, confirms the M.P.A. and J.D.).
Commissioned in the United States Air Force and served as an intelligence briefer to senior command (Governor Gordon appointment announcement, July 30, 2022).

Wyoming House of Representatives, District 4, 2003–2012; House Majority Whip, 2007–2008; House Majority Floor Leader, 2009–2010; Speaker of the House, 2011–2012 (Wyoming Legislature member profile). WyoVote legislator rosters, which start in 2008, list House H04 for 2008–2012.

The July 30, 2022, gubernatorial announcement also states that he had served as chief prosecutor in the Laramie County District Attorney's office and as an attorney in private practice with Sawyer, Warren, Buchanan, and that he is a longtime resident of Goshen County.

Governor Mark Gordon appointed him District Court Judge for the Eighth Judicial District on July 30, 2022. He resigned as Secretary of State on Sept. 15, 2022 (official State Officers Roster). The Wyoming Judicial Branch posted a robing-ceremony notice on Dec. 9, 2022, for Judge Edward A. Buchanan of the Eighth Judicial District (Converse, Goshen, Niobrara, and Platte Counties).
